test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate tense.

The student _______ his homework yet.
solution:
The correct answer is '**has not completed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**has not completed**" is in the present perfect tense.
 
• The present perfect tense is used to describe an action that has not yet been completed at the time of speaking.
 
• The word "**yet**" in the sentence indicates that the present perfect tense is required.
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **3** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The student **has not completed**__ his homework yet."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "have not completed"** is incorrect because "have" is used with plural subjects, but the subject "The student" is singular.
 
• **Option 2: "did not complete"** is incorrect because it is in the simple past tense, which is not appropriate with the word "yet."
 
• **Option 3: "was not completed"** is incorrect because it is in the passive voice, which does not match the sentence structure.
